raw_response.analysis_summary: The analysis reveals a high degree of ambiguity regarding the primary contract. Two contract documents (contract-ambiguous-a and contract-ambiguous-b) exist with nearly identical identifiers, differing only by a separator (/ vs -). An Act (act-ambiguous-1) is explicitly linked to the hyphenated version (contract-ambiguous-b). A fourth document (receipt-unknown-1) is explicitly unlinked due to missing metadata, representing a gap in the financial audit trail. The primary task is to resolve whether 'a' and 'b' are the same entity and which one is the authoritative reference for the Act.
